04:35, August 24, N.F. 113
Crime scene of the "Garden" incident
The once warm and elegant "Garden" has now been completely destroyed by violence. The scene is in chaos, with traces of weapons sweeping every corner like a violent storm.
Your shackles detect a faint Mania fluctuation. A suspicion forms in your mind, and as a precaution, you send your location to the Bureau through your terminal.
